reasoning: HSS8(outline 9.9)只規定 widget 標題為「Shortcuts」。單一驗證標的,不拆。ER 必須是「標題文字為 Shortcuts」的直接讀取結果,而非「標題正確」——後者不是可觀察陳述。標題在 Home Screen 上的 widget 與 Edit state 的 Shortcuts Layout 畫面都會出現,但 HSS8 只主張 widget 標題,故程序僅讀 widget 本身,不擴及編輯畫面。優先級:屬顯示規格細節,對主功能無影響,訂 P3。

tcs.test_item:
The system shall implement Widget Title Definition: HSS8.) Widget title for this feature is "Shortcuts".

(Shortcuts widget displayed on a Home Screen page -> its title reads "Shortcuts")
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle speed is 0
2. A Shortcuts widget is placed on a Home Screen page
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Navigate to the Home Screen page that contains the Shortcuts widget
2. Read the title displayed on the Shortcuts widget
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen page with the Shortcuts widget is displayed
2. The widget title reads "Shortcuts"
